newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET ENDS FLAT IN MIXED TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET ENDS FLAT IN MIXED TRADE.

text.p: Stocks on the Romanian over-the-counter (OTC) market stood still on Tuesday with most investors sidelined for the summer break, operators said.
"Trading was subdued and no major factors are likely to change the market picture in the coming days," one said.
Two independent indices inched down, while another went up.
The VAB-RA all-share index eased by 0.6 percent to 6,445.5 points and the BIG-OTC inched down 0.12 percent to 4,597.03 points. The CAS-RQ gained 0.56 percent to 1,000 points.
Gainers outran fallers by 160 to 153. Prices for 274 stocks marked time.
Some profit-taking eroded previous gains by bearing makers, one trader said, adding that those stocks might stay in a bearish phase on Wednesday.
Rulmenti Suceava, a bearing producer, tumbled 4,500 lei to 12,500, while competitor Rulmenti Brasov closed 400 lei weaker to 1,200.
State-run cement maker Romcim closed flat at 122,000 lei, though some deals were struck at 124,000 at midsession.

Traders said an expected announcement of selected bidders for Romcim's sell-off was unlikely to have an immediate impact on trading. The State Ownership Fund (FPS), the majority holder of Romcim, is expected to make the announcement on Wednesday.
Among the session's best performers was oil refinery Arpechim, which added 2,000 lei to close at 40,000.
Overall turnover slipped to 17.62 billion lei from Monday's 19.77 billion.
